name: SOWI Bistro
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to SOWI Bistro in Innsbruck** – where tradition meets modern flair in the heart of **Tirol**. Indulge in our authentic **Tiroler** cuisine, from hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** to crispy **Speckknödel**, all crafted with local ingredients. Enjoy cozy corners, craft beers, and a relaxed atmosphere—perfect for a break after exploring **Innsbruck**’s charm. Whether you’re here for business or pleasure, we’re your go-to spot for a taste of **Tirol**’s best.
Try our daily specials:
  • **Tiroler Gröstl** – a rustic mix of potatoes, onions, and meat
  • **Apfelstrudel** with vanilla sauce
  • Freshly brewed **Tiroler** coffee and homemade cakes
**SOWI Bistro** – good food, good vibes, and the spirit of **Tirol**.
